n1.text: That was Dad, speaking out loud. He can also type, if he prefers.

n2.text: ForeverYours is a voice companion for Dad, briefed by his family. When his safety is at stake, it raises a flag for his daughter, and tells him first, out loud. Everything else he says stays between them.

n3.text: His daughter briefs it once, from work. One line: a check-up with Dr. Tan on Thursday. Nothing to set up on Dad's side.

n4a.text: When Dad asks, it already knows what she typed.

n4b.text: The reply is written by NVIDIA Nemotron on Nebius Token Factory.

n5a.text: What he says in private stays private. His daughter sees no flag, and none of his words.

n5b.text: Danger is different. Safety rules catch this before the model does.

n6.text: Next day, in a local test, it's still briefed.

n7.text: Two models on Nebius Token Factory: Nemotron 3 Nano writes the replies, and Nemotron 3 Super is the safety backstop. Hearing and voice run on the app's own server, so his voice recording never goes to Nebius.

n8.text: This is a prototype: it can miss nuance, so it does not replace human judgment or emergency services. Try it yourself, no login, at the link on screen.
